Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National IGNITE expands product ecosystem at Atlantis Dubai, appoints media mogul ‘Bola Ray’ to Global Advisory Board to drive African entrepreneurship Source : IGNITE Social Enterprise 20 October 2026 2:06pm Audio By Carbonatix
IGNITE Social Enterprise has announced the expansion of its lifestyle and wellness product ecosystem alongside the official unveiling of its Global Advisory Board, featuring Ghanaian media icon and CEO of EIB Network Group, Nathan Kwabena Anokye Adisi, popularly known as Bola Ray.
The announcement was made on stage during a regional launch event at the Atlantis Dubai, underscoring IGNITE’s mission to connect African micro-entrepreneurs, digital creators, and trade leaders to global social commerce pipelines.
Advancing Ghana’s Digital Economy and Entrepreneurial Landscape
Ghana continues to establish itself as a prominent hub for youth-led enterprise, digital commerce, and innovation across West Africa. As informal trade transitions rapidly into structured digital economies, IGNITE’s social commerce model provides micro-entrepreneurs and brand affiliates with structured training, turn-key digital tools, and consumer product lines to build resilient independent businesses.
The appointment of Nathan Kwabena Anokye Adisi (Bola Ray) places an influential Ghanaian voice at the strategic core of IGNITE’s global roadmap. Known for driving creative enterprise, media innovation, and youth empowerment across the continent, Bola Ray bridges local market dynamics with global trade strategy.
"Across Ghana and Africa, thousands of ambitious individuals are seeking practical pathways to acquire digital skills, launch viable businesses, and generate sustainable wealth," said Bola Ray, Global Advisory Board Member at IGNITE. "IGNITE is not merely introducing consumer items; it is architecting an enduring socio-economic ecosystem. By pairing a practical AI-based learning platform with curated, high-demand lifestyle products, we are unlocking meaningful earning avenues for local entrepreneurs and elevating African participation in the global marketplace."

Product rollouts across West African territories will be introduced systematically in alignment with local regulatory approvals and market readiness.
The IGNITE Global Advisory Board serves as an independent consultative body guiding ethical corporate governance, sustainable expansion, and cross-border trade ethics across Asia, the Middle East, and Sub-Saharan Africa.
Chaired by Malaysian corporate leader Dato’ Sri Subahan Kamal, the board unites interdisciplinary leaders including:
"As IGNITE scales across Sub-Saharan Africa, Asia, and the Middle East, our growth must remain grounded in ethical transparency and tangible socio-economic value for the communities we enter," said Dato’ Sri Subahan Kamal, Chairman of the IGNITE Global Advisory Board. "Bola Ray’s deep insight into African enterprise and youth culture will ensure IGNITE's footprint in Ghana and across the continent is built on a sustainable, long-term foundation."
Founded in 2026 and headquartered in Hong Kong, IGNITE is a global social enterprise that helps micro-entrepreneurs grow their businesses through an innovative social e-commerce model that combines high-quality products and future-ready services.
Driven by the mission to Own Your Future , IGNITE provides individuals worldwide with modern digital tools, training, and premium wellness and lifestyle product lines designed to support financial independence, personal growth, and professional success.
